detectors.title: Private key material
detectors.validation: Confirm key ownership and revoke or rotate the corresponding certificate, SSH key, or signing identity.

detectors.title: GitHub access token
detectors.validation: Validate only through authorized GitHub token inventory or audit logs; revoke before any active use test.

detectors.title: AWS access key identifier
detectors.validation: Locate the key in the authorized AWS account, disable it, and inspect CloudTrail before rotation.

detectors.title: Google API key
detectors.validation: Check project ownership and API restrictions in Google Cloud without invoking the key against an API.

detectors.title: Slack token
detectors.validation: Identify the Slack app or workspace and revoke the token before reviewing access logs.

detectors.title: Stripe secret key
detectors.validation: Confirm ownership in Stripe, roll the key, and review API request logs; never issue a transaction for validation.

detectors.title: SendGrid API key
detectors.validation: Confirm the key identifier in the provider console, revoke it, and inspect mail activity.

detectors.title: Brevo API key
detectors.validation: Confirm the key in the Brevo account, revoke it, rotate dependent deployments, and inspect sending logs.

detectors.title: MongoDB URI with embedded credentials
detectors.validation: Rotate the database user and inspect database and network audit logs; do not connect with the discovered credential.

detectors.title: URL with embedded credentials
detectors.validation: Identify the destination and credential owner, revoke the credential, and review destination logs.

detectors.title: JSON Web Token
detectors.validation: Decode locally only; identify issuer and session family, then revoke or rotate the signing/session material.

detectors.title: Bearer credential
detectors.validation: Identify the issuing system from surrounding metadata and revoke the credential without replaying it.

detectors.title: High-entropy secret assignment
detectors.validation: Confirm ownership through the relevant provider inventory; do not replay the value.

findings.title: High-entropy secret assignment
findings.validation: Confirm whether SERVICE_API_TOKEN is a live credential using the owning provider inventory; do not replay it.

suppression.reason: Synthetic high-entropy regression fixture from Phase 3 development history; it is not a provider credential and has no runtime use.
